en.headline: CHP investigates measles case involving 35-year-old woman, 198 contacts
en.dek: The non-locally born patient developed fever and cough from 4 August and a rash on 9 August; she is in stable condition and 198 close contacts are under medical surveillance.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a measles case involving a 35-year-old woman who lives in Sau Mau Ping Estate in Kwun Tong. She developed fever and cough from 4 August and a rash on 9 August, attending the Accident and Emergency Department of United Christian Hospital that day. Laboratory testing confirmed measles and she did not require hospital admission. Her condition is stable.

Epidemiological investigation showed the patient was not born in Hong Kong and is uncertain whether she received measles vaccination in her place of birth. She had a short trip outside Hong Kong during the incubation period. She did not need to attend work during the communicable period from 5 to 13 August, and her household contacts have remained asymptomatic.

As of 3 p.m. on Tuesday, 198 people had been identified as close contacts and placed under medical surveillance. None had developed measles symptoms. This is the ninth measles case recorded in Hong Kong this year; earlier cases included six imported or epidemiologically linked cases and two local cases.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查35歲女子麻疹個案 198人列密切接觸者
zh.dek: 患者非本港出生，8月4日起發燒咳嗽，9日出現皮疹，情況穩定；198名密切接觸者暫無病徵，正接受醫學監察。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心正調查一宗麻疹個案，涉及一名居於觀塘秀茂坪邨的35歲女子。她於8月4日起出現發燒和咳嗽，8月9日出現皮疹，當日到基督教聯合醫院急症室求診，臨床樣本證實對麻疹呈陽性反應，毋須入院，現時情況穩定。
流行病學調查顯示，病人並非在本港出生，不確定曾否在出生地接種麻疹疫苗。她於潛伏期內曾短暫離港旅遊。病人在傳染期（8月5日至13日）毋須上班，家居接觸者沒有出現麻疹病徵。
截至星期二下午3時，共有198人被列為密切接觸者，正接受中心的醫學監察，暫時沒有密切接觸者出現麻疹病徵。此個案是本港今年錄得的第9宗麻疹個案，早前6宗為外地輸入或相關個案，2宗為本地個案。
